name: hive-x402 payment rail as a public reference implementation
asks: Adapt x402's challenge/verify/settle semantics to Hive: a 402 response carries a Hive payment requirement (transfer with memo nonce, or hive-engine token transfer), the client pays on-chain, the facilitator verifies the transaction against public RPC and issues the settlement proof, and every crossing is witnessed as RDF/PROV exactly as paid-ephemeris-gateway already does on Base. Nobody has built this on Hive; publishing it as a spec plus an Apache-2.0 reference implementation (sibling of x402-boundary-reference) makes the Union the reference facilitator for an entire chain, and every future Union Hive service inherits the rail for free.
